name: xyne-island-video
description: Remotion compositions for Xyne Island launch assets

scripts.assets: npm run hero:gif && npm run film && cp out/xyne-island-hero-loop.gif ../../docs/xyne-island-hero-loop.gif && cp out/xyne-island-launch.mp4 ../../docs/xyne-island-launch.mp4
scripts.tour: remotion render TourFilm out/xyne-island-tour-silent.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p && npm run tour:sound
scripts.tour:sound: python3 sound/tour-sound.py out/tour-sound.wav && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/xyne-island-tour-silent.mp4 -i out/tour-sound.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 160k -shortest out/xyne-island-tour.mp4 && cp out/xyne-island-tour.mp4 ../../docs/xyne-island-tour.mp4
